title: Amawal apuni
lede: Suffètes, tophet, Cothon, shekel neɣ diekplous : awalen n ddunit taqarṭaǧit yettwaseqdacen deg usmel-agi, ttwabeggnen s kra n yisekkilen, s tira-nsen tafiniqit akked yisebtar anda ara ten-tafem.
heroAlt: Azru apuni ițwaɣzan s ucaraf n Tanit
searchLabel: Nadi awal, s tefransist, s tanglizit neɣ s taɛrabt
noteText: Tafiniqit ur tettaru ara akk inzizen n wawal : tirawin-agi n ugemmay ɣren-t seg uyeffus ɣer uzelmaḍ, ma d tifuyla tifransisin, tanglizin neɣ tiɛrabin n yismawen d tilɣa i d-yekkan seg tegrikit d tlatinit. Iɣbula iqdimen yettwabedren ttwaseglen deg tebibliyugrafit.
links.0.title: Tutlayt d tira
links.0.text: Asekkil afiniqi, tira tipunit akked yisem-ik·im s tefiniqit.
links.1.title: Iɣbula d tebibliyugrafit
links.1.text: Polybe, Tite-Live, Appien akked idlisen imaynuten yettwabedren deg tegzayin n wawalen.
metaDesc: Amawal s tlata n tutlayin n ddunit tapunit : suffète, tophet, Cothon, Byrsa, Barcides, shekel, garum, quinquérème, Tanit, Baal Hammon... Tigzayin, tira tifiniqiyin d iseɣwanen.
